}

  nextSub?: Link

  watchInstance: unknown

  watchTraverseRoot: unknown

  schedulerFlushIndex: number | undefined
  schedulerPendingPost: any[] | undefined
  schedulerActivePost: any[] | null | undefined
  schedulerPostIndex: number | undefined
  schedulerFlushing: boolean | undefined
  schedulerFlushPending: boolean | undefined
  schedulerCurrentPromise: Promise<void> | null | undefined

  schedulerSeen: Map<any, number> | undefined

  pendingTriggerDeps: any[] | undefined
  lastTriggerTarget: object | undefined
  lastTriggerType: TriggerOpTypes | undefined
  lastTriggerKey: unknown
  lastTrackedTarget: object | undefined

        prevShouldTrack: boolean

    this.watchCallback = cb
    this.watchDeep = deep
    this.watchForceTrigger = forceTrigger
    this.watchMultiSource = isMultiSource
    this.watchOldValue = oldValue
    this.watchInstance = instance
    this.watchCleanupFn = undefined
  }

    this.watchForceTrigger = forceTrigger

    this.watchForceTrigger = false
    this.watchMultiSource = false

    }

  }
